title: {session}-hypothesis.json
description: Step 4 output. Persists original_prompt verbatim plus hypothesis, complexity_hint, structured anti-bias alternatives, and optional discovered_paths. Consumed by step 6 discovery seeds, step 7 economy classifier, step 13 reflector, step 15 inline summary. See apex-core.md step 4.

original_prompt.description: Verbatim user prompt - do NOT paraphrase

hypothesis.description: 1-2 sentence working interpretation; not a plan, not a task list

complexity_hint.description: Advisory; one signal consumed by step 7 economy classifier

alternatives.description: 1-3 narrower / broader scope readings; structured anti-bias check step 4 cannot skip.

discovered_paths.description: Optional. Repo-relative file paths the orchestrator validated during step-4 inline exploration (Glob / Grep / Read on conceptual prompts where the user named no file paths). Consumed by step 6 discovery as additional seeds and by the cascade-empty proceed-with-discovered-or-prompt-paths fallback. Empty / absent when the prompt itself names paths or when step-4 did no exploration.

goals.description: Optional. 1..N discrete actionable goals derived from original_prompt. Free-text 1-3 sentences each. Single-task prompts emit one goal; multi-task / audit prompts enumerate. goals.length drives step 6 top-K (1->15, 2-5->30, >5->50), step 7 deterministic tier rule, step 8.2 per-goal task split (N goals -> N executor tasks), step 13 non-convergence detection, step 15 per-goal summary. Backward-compatible: old hypothesis JSONs without goals[] still validate; new flow always populates.
